run.//: Run the atlas pipeline harness. Pass --flows X,Y to limit, or no args for full run.

dumps.//: ADR-0004 §3 / issue #23 — THE regeneration target for the D1–D4 CardAtlas dumps. Runs the four flows in dependency order (CorpusParse → FetchCombos → CardAtlas → ComboAnchors), then PUBLISHES the produced dumps to the repo-root gitignored `dumps/` — the known path the atlas-api seeder reads (Atlas:*Path in apps/atlas-api/appsettings.json). Consumers never fall back to a committed copy: they fail loudly naming this target. Cold cost is dominated by the ~38k-card corpus parse (measured 48.8 s in the mast harness, issue #22); warm runs are cache-served in well under a second. Only the LEAF copy is rewritten — no upstream artifact is touched, which matters because Flowthru fingerprints file items on mtime:size, not content (flowthru#148), so rewriting an upstream file cascades a full re-run of everything below it even when the bytes are identical.

purge.//: Wipe all auto-generated data files from intermediate/primary layers.
